svg.title: Your browser. Agent ready.
svg.desc: Native to your Mac: WebKit is already there. A small Swift app gives your agent direct browser commands. Sign in once. Keep going: Persistent accounts in Umbra’s own store. Your agents pick up the session across commands. Your screen stays yours: Browse invisibly in the background. Bring a page forward for sign-in or a human handoff. One session. Every tool: Shell, MCP, Python, TypeScript and Swift share live tabs. Bring Codex, Claude Code or Cursor. Agents that work together: Named tabs, ownership leases, bounded admission, deadlines and cancellation coordinate parallel work. Read less. Do more: Observe changes, extract typed records, batch checked steps and resume explicit checkpoints.
